SokHem CC BY 4.0 municipal export is rolling with last sale 2026-10-10; apartment-only scope and annual 2025 area data absent. The separate RegSO neighbourhood web table is rolling twelve months and has no observed openly licensed 2025 export.

Maklarstatistik has public Excel buttons and annual-history chart labels, but downloads fall under contractual terms; do not accept terms or reconstruct a neighbourhood dataset. Research access/historical export permission needs separate approval.
SCB RegSO 2025_v2 municipal mask remains resolved with documented limits. It does not establish native housing areas or a residential price source.
Final Step 6 joins/reference frame and Step 8 coverage/group support remain pending.
